description.name: Basic Attack
Alt Attack
Dodge
Dash Attack
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Perform a forward slash, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

description.name: Dodge Counter
Special Attack
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Lunge forward with three consecutive thrusts, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

description.name: EX Special Attack: Stage 1
description.desc:
When Energy is sufficient and not in <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight's Focus]</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Launch a powerful rapid thrust forward, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
This skill is considered a <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight Skill]</color>;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: EX Special Attack: Phase 2
description.desc:
When Energy is sufficient and in <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight's Focus]</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Launch a powerful series of charging thrusts forward, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
This skill is considered a <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight Skill]</color>;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Chain Attack
Ultimate
Quick Assist
description.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Dash forward with freezing force, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Defensive Assist
description.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist Follow-Up
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Swing the spear upward and follow up with a heavy downward smash, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1591012.name: Quick Assist:
1591012.desc: <IconMap:Icon_Switch>（Switch in when an ally uses [EX Special Attack]）

name: Core Passive
Additional Ability
desc:
<color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack]</color> Stage 4, <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Chain Attack]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Ultimate]</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>[Dodge Counter]</color> are considered <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight Skills]</color>;
When Sigrid hits an enemy with any <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight Skill]</color>, if she is not currently in <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight's Focus]</color>, she enters <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight's Focus]</color>, and the <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight Skill]</color> that landed the hit enters <color=#FFFFFF>[Inactive]</color> status. She also gains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>[Alt Attack]</color> charge, which can be stored up to 1 time;
While in <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight's Focus]</color>, if Sigrid uses any <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight Skill]</color> that is not in <color=#FFFFFF>[Inactive]</color> status, she can refresh <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight's Focus]</color> and gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>[Alt Attack]</color> charge, which can be stored up to 1 time; Upon refreshing <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight's Focus]</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>[Inactive]</color> status transfers to the newly used <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight Skill]</color>;
When an <color=#FFFFFF>[Alt Attack]</color> hits an enemy, the <color=#FFFFFF>[Inactive]</color> status is removed, and the next <color=#FFFFFF>[Alt Attack]</color>'s stage increases by 1, up to a maximum of Stage 3; After using the Stage 3 <color=#FFFFFF>[Alt Attack]</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>[Alt Attack]</color> stage immediately resets to Stage 1, and <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight's Focus]</color> ends;
The duration of <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight's Focus]</color> decreases as the <color=#FFFFFF>[Alt Attack]</color> stage increases: at Stage 1/2/3, the duration is <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>7</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>6</color>s respectively;
When <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight's Focus]</color> ends, the <color=#FFFFFF>[Alt Attack]</color> stage decreases by 1, down to a minimum of Stage 1;
When activating or refreshing <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight's Focus]</color>, Sigrid's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s; Repeated triggers can extend the duration by <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s, up to a maximum duration of <color=#FFFFFF>40</color>s;
While in <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight's Focus]</color>, the Energy Cost of <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack]</color> is reduced.

1.name: Mindscape Cinema I
1.desc: After the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>[Alt Attack]</color>, enter <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight's Focus]</color>; while in <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight's Focus]</color>, using <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack]</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>[Alt Attack]</color> then pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> allows you to follow up with an enhanced version of <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack]</color> 2nd hit; DMG dealt by the character is increased by <color=#FFFFFF>40%</color>.

2.name: Mindscape Cinema II
2.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight Skill]</color> deals <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> that ignores <color=#FFFFFF>24%</color> of the target's DEF; the duration of <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight Skill]</color> effects is extended; <color=#FFFFFF>[Assist Attack]</color> is treated as a <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight Skill]</color>.

4.name: Mindscape Cinema IV
4.desc: Each time <color=#FFFFFF>[Knight's Focus]</color> is refreshed, gain a <color=#FFFFFF>20%</color> ATK bonus for <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s. Repeated triggers can extend the duration by <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s, up to a maximum of <color=#FFFFFF>40</color>s.

6.name: Mindscape Cinema VI
6.desc: While in <color=#FFFFFF>[All-Out Assault State]</color>, holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> directly triggers the 3rd Segment of <color=#FFFFFF>[Alt Attack]</color>; when the 3rd Segment of <color=#FFFFFF>[Alt Attack]</color> hits an enemy, it deals an additional <color=#FFFFFF>2,000%</color> DMG.
